title: Bears showed their resiliency in their win over the Patriots
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Mark Grote and producer Adam Studzinski discuss how resilient the Bears were in their victory over the Patriots on Thursday Night Football.

title: Wiederer & Grote react to Bears' win over Patriots after hearing from players postgame
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote caught up with each other at Solider Field after speaking with players in the Bears' locker room about their 30-24 win over the Patriots.
